facts.fact: 章首：钉海报——前夜抵达破败小镇 Avernon
facts.anchor: Andra slammed the nail into the wooden post with a flat rock. The afternoon sun was finally on its descent

facts.fact: 拍卖场前立誓：阻止暗魔法蔓延后，下一个就来烧掉这黑暗
facts.anchor: spreading through her village and across the continent, she would come for this darkness next.

facts.fact: 铁匠铺四金币卖刀——她听出猎人嗓音，认出他也在镇上
facts.anchor: Four gold coins. Final offer.” His voice was smoky and gruff from years working at the fire.

facts.fact: Marie 称怪物寄养在镇上友人牧场，Hachar 正备今晚表演
facts.anchor: Hachar is with them now, getting them ready for tonight.

facts.fact: 问 Lucas——Marie 说他还和 Jasper 采购物资；不安加重
facts.anchor: Still with Jasper, collecting some last minute supplies.

facts.fact: Marie 面具摘下：只是表演还挺赚钱，今晚演完明早走
facts.anchor: It’s just an act, dear. A show that brings in a fair amount of coin, I might add.

facts.fact: 剪子藏进裙层防身，独自溜向斗兽场
facts.anchor: Carefully, she pulled them from the bag and hid them amongst her dress’s many layers

facts.fact: 暗处目睹 Hachar 抽倒钩鞭逼双笼怪物“醒来表演”
facts.anchor: Hachar pulled a whip, and Andra squinted to see the sharp barbs attached to the entirety of the thick braided lash.

facts.fact: 笼中兽金眼盯着她、口鼻沾药粉——她猜出缬草根，兽缓缓眨眼
facts.anchor: Andra noted the tan powder around the beast's muzzle before exhaustion forced its head to rest once more.

facts.fact: 第二只兽推开“该锁着”的笼门无声跃地——它自己救了自己
facts.anchor: the cage that was supposed to be locked opened, a giant paw stepping out before the beast silently leaped to the ground.

facts.fact: 毒电杆围刺跃出之兽直至瘫倒——She had never witnessed anything like it
facts.anchor: half a dozen men circled the monster. They held poles of some sort and shouted profanities

facts.fact: 决赛幕：暗刀扎大兽腿——它“带着悔意扑了上去”
facts.anchor: and embedded itself into the thigh of the larger beast. It roared, and with regret etched onto its features, it pounced.
